object:horn / frost horn.visualDescription: A curved cream bone horn has a wide dark bell, dotted side tooling, and an upturned narrow tip.
object:horn / frost horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the frost horn as a magical bone horn whose use sends a blast of cold.
object:horn / frost horn.modelBrief: Reuse the shared ivory horn silhouette with dark hollow mouth; keep cold projection as an effect, not permanent ice.

object:horn / fire horn.visualDescription: The tile repeats the same cream curved horn with brown mouth and dotted side.
object:horn / fire horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the fire horn as the fire-affinity counterpart to the frost horn.
object:horn / fire horn.modelBrief: Reuse the ordinary horn geometry and palette; its fire blast belongs to gameplay or animation.

object:horn / horn of plenty.visualDescription: The same short ivory horn curves upward and shows a dark open bell and small carved dots.
object:horn / horn of plenty.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the horn of plenty as a magical bone horn that produces food or potions from charges.
object:horn / horn of plenty.modelBrief: Reuse the shared bone horn appearance without showing food stuffed inside.

object:harp / wooden harp.visualDescription: A small brown harp has a tall vertical post, curved neck, flat base, and several pale blue strings.
object:harp / wooden harp.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the wooden harp as a non-magical wooden tonal instrument.
object:harp / wooden harp.modelBrief: Build a compact standing harp with dark reddish frame and thin pale strings.

object:harp / magic harp.visualDescription: The tile repeats the brown standing harp with curved arm and light strings.
object:harp / magic harp.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic harp as a magical wooden instrument capable of taming nearby monsters.
object:harp / magic harp.modelBrief: Reuse the plain harp model; keep its taming effect separate from the wood and strings.

object:bell.visualDescription: A small gold handbell stands upright with a slim handle, flared body, and burgundy shadow on one side.
object:bell.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the bell as a copper atonal instrument distinct from the special Bell of Opening.
object:bell.modelBrief: Make a simple polished gold-colored handbell with slender grip and flared bell body.

object:bugle.visualDescription: A brass bugle points right with a wide yellow bell, long straight tubing, and dark red looped lower pipe.
object:bugle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the bugle as a copper tonal instrument without a magical counterpart.
object:bugle.modelBrief: Build a compact valveless brass bugle with looped tube and large flared bell.

object:drum / leather drum.visualDescription: A round brown leather drum has a pale taut top, woodlike vertical sides, and darker bottom rim.
object:drum / leather drum.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the leather drum as a non-magical atonal instrument.
object:drum / leather drum.modelBrief: Make a squat cylindrical hand drum with cream skin head and reddish-brown body.

object:drum / drum of earthquake.visualDescription: The tile repeats the same brown drum with pale head and dark lower rim.
object:drum / drum of earthquake.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the drum of earthquake as a magical leather drum that can cause an earthquake when charged.
object:drum / drum of earthquake.modelBrief: Reuse the plain drum appearance; ground cracking should occur only as an effect.

object:pick-axe.visualDescription: A steel pick-axe has a pointed double-ended head, short wooden socket, and long diagonal brown handle.
object:pick-axe.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the pick-axe as an iron digging tool that can also serve as a weapon.
object:pick-axe.modelBrief: Build a long wood haft with a dark steel curved pick on one side and shorter blunt edge on the other.

object:grappling hook.visualDescription: A gray multi-pronged grappling hook is attached to a tan-brown rope coil near its base.
object:grappling hook.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the grappling hook as an iron hook tool used to snag or pull things at range.
object:grappling hook.modelBrief: Model a heavy three- or four-pronged steel hook with attached coil of brown rope.

object:unicorn horn.visualDescription: A long tapered unicorn horn lies diagonally, brown at its broad base and pale cream toward its sharp tip.
object:unicorn horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the unicorn horn as a bone tool and weapon used to cure several harmful conditions.
object:unicorn horn.modelBrief: Sculpt a single spiraled tapering horn with tan base and ivory tip; keep healing effects separate.
